about.title: Rolling Pebble
about.tagline: App local para importar, temporizar, editar e publicar letras sincronizadas.
about.whatItDoesText: Rolling Pebble combines lyrics import, automatic timing, manual correction, export, and LRCLIB publishing in a local WebUI. Audio processing and Auto Timing run locally.
about.feature1: Import lyrics from LRCLIB or local .lrc / .txt files.
about.feature2: Create a single-song project from a local audio file.
about.feature3: Generate synced lyrics with Auto Timing and correct them manually.
about.author: Author
about.authorText: Rolling Pebble is created and maintained by Harmonese, an Electronic duo from China.
about.creditsText: The synchronizer and editor experience is based on magic-akari/lrc-maker. Auto Timing is powered by Harmonese/py-roller, and LRCLIB integration is powered by Harmonese/pylrclib.
about.rightsNoteText: Please make sure you have the rights to submit or publish lyrics, and respect each lyrics source and platform.
